newsitem.title: UK: BZW hires Fleming food and drink financier.
newsitem.headline: BZW hires Fleming food and drink financier.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of British banking giant Barclays Plc, said on Wednesday its corporate finance department had hired John Spayne from Robert Fleming to develop its presence in the food and drinks industry.
BZW said in a statement that Spayne, 36, had created and successfully developed British merchant bank Flemings' own food and beverages industry specialisation.

"We are delighted that someone of John's calibre and international experience will be spearheading our coverage of this large and complex industry," said Richard Gillingwater, BZW's joint head of corporate finance.

Gillingwater said the firm expected the "food markets of Europe and the U.S. to continue to consolidate in the face of increasing retailer concentration and the opening up of emerging markets for the major global food players".
